images.author: Sakana AI; photographer uncredited
images.why: Best subject match: actual Azabudai Hills reception with illuminated sakana.ai signage, warm lighting and uncluttered furniture below. Suitable for a portrait crop retaining the logo. Pixel dimensions could not be independently verified.

images.author: SHINTARO YOSHIMATSU
images.why: David Ha and Llion Jones photographed in their office, with striking blue lighting. A 2560-pixel-wide rendition is indexed; crop carefully to preserve both founders.

images.author: Johan Carlberg/SVD/TT
images.why: Anton Osika and Fabian Hedin together in a bright office. The indexed rendition requests 1900 × 1267 pixels; their close positioning suits a tighter portrait crop with text beneath their faces.

images.author: Lovable; photographer uncredited
images.why: Official team photograph with heart gestures and a warm yellow backdrop. The indexed image URL requests up to 2672 pixels, but native dimensions were not verified. A 9:10 crop would retain only part of the group.

images.author: Black Forest
images.why: Andreas Blattmann and Robin Rombach overlooking Freiburg, wearing shirts with visible company branding. Warm light and a subdued background suit an info card. The source uses a 1920-pixel image variant; delivered dimensions were not independently verified.

images.author: Black Forest Labs / Salesforce Ventures; photographer uncredited
images.why: Investor-published photograph explicitly captioned as the Black Forest Labs leadership team. Original-file URL avoids the page's 1024-pixel resize; original resolution and download availability could not be verified.

images.author: Kimberly White/Getty Images
images.why: Ilya Sutskever photographed at SSI's Palo Alto office on August 19, 2025. A single-subject composition suits 9:10 cropping. This is a published editorial image, not a watermarked agency preview; the linked file's dimensions remain unverified.
